## Q32 Bio to Participate in Upcoming September Investor Conferences


September 1, 2026


[PDF Version](https://ir.q32bio.com/node/11176/pdf)


WALTHAM, Mass.


, Sept. 1, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- Q32 Bio Inc. (Nasdaq: QTTB) ("Q32 Bio"), a clinical stage biotechnology company focused on developing innovative therapies for alopecia areata ("AA") and other autoimmune and inflammatory diseases, today announced that management will participate in three upcoming investor conferences in September:


**Wells Fargo 21st Annual Healthcare Conference** Date: Tuesday, September 8, 2026
Fireside Chat Presentation Time: 3:45 p.m. E.T.
Location: Boston, MA


**Cantor Global Healthcare Conference 2026** Date: Wednesday, September 9, 2026
Fireside Chat Presentation Time: 3:55 p.m. E.T.
Location: New York, NY


**Morgan Stanley 24th Annual Global Healthcare Conference** Date: Tuesday, September 15, 2026
Fireside Chat Presentation Time: 11:30 a.m. E.T.
Location: New York, NY


A webcast of each presentation will be available on the Events and Presentations page of Q32 Bio's website at[www.q32bio.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4763861-1&h=875567625&u=https%3A%2F%2Fir.q32bio.com%2Fnews-and-events%2Fevents-presentations&a=www.q32bio.com) . Archived replays will be available for 90 days following each event.


**About Q32 Bio**


Q32 Bio is a clinical stage biotechnology company whose science targets potent regulators of the adaptive immune system to re-balance immunity and is focused on developing innovative therapies for alopecia areata and other autoimmune and inflammatory diseases. About 700,000 people in the United States live with alopecia areata1, a disease which has a life-altering impact on patients and limited current treatment options. Q32 Bio is advancing bempikibart (ADX-914), a fully human anti-IL-7Rα antibody that re-regulates adaptive immune function, for the treatment of alopecia areata in an ongoing Phase 2 program. The IL-7 and TSLP pathways have been genetically and biologically implicated in driving several T cell-mediated pathological processes in numerous autoimmune diseases.


For more information, visit[www.Q32Bio.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4763861-1&h=1035754374&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.q32bio.com%2F&a=www.Q32Bio.com) .


1National Alopecia Areata Foundation
